FACTOR

Factor Definition

Sampled Mean Ratio

Samples price points at fixed phase intervals on the base bars. Higher values mean the current price is stronger relative to its same-phase history; the input is not resampled into natural slower-horizon bars.

Factor Formula close(t) / mean(close(t-k*sample_interval), k=0..sample_count-1) - 1
